TABLE.NAME: block_deadline_checker_task
TABLE.COMMENT: Deadlines a learner has added for themselves. Course deadlines are not stored here: those are read from the calendar, and the course owns them.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The learner the deadline belongs to. Nobody else may read or write it.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course the learner filed it under, or null when it belongs to no course.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: What the learner called it. Plain text.

FIELD.NAME: due
FIELD.COMMENT: Due date as a unix timestamp.

FIELD.NAME: timecompleted
FIELD.COMMENT: When the learner ticked it off; 0 while it is still outstanding.

INDEX.NAME: userid-due
INDEX.COMMENT: Every read is one learner's deadlines in date order.
